task: Author ADR-085 (cross-harness permission-surface asymmetry) for issue #3217: record why migrating the two survivor guard hooks (skill_first_guard, test_auto_approval) to host-native permissions is not the clean swap #3217 assumed. Run the 6-agent adr-review and land the ADR plus debate log. Continue epic #3197.

events.content: Authored ADR-085 documenting two verified findings that falsify the #3217 clean-migration premise: Copilot has no repo-committed permission surface and skill_first_guard self-neuters in consumer repos (Finding 1); Claude permissions.allow splits on separators but not command substitution or redirects, so migrating test_auto_approval widens an auto-approve path (Finding 2, risk 7/10). Added a portability-and-fidelity eligibility test and two open owner decisions D-A and D-B.

Ran the mandated 6-agent adr-review skill (architect, critic, security, analyst, high-level-advisor, independent-thinker) as parallel subagents. Consensus 5 ACCEPT + 1 Disagree-and-Commit, 0 P0. Resolved all 11 P1 threads in the ADR (added the delete option, made the ADR-084 rule 4 tension explicit, led Finding 2 with the deny-scope argument, added risk score, staleness trigger, confirmation mechanism, and rule 3 basis). Captured the dissent and verified provenance dates via git log.
